Remark
[Eigenvalues and Helmholtz's equation] ↗ def:spectrum-of-operator 1. ch6:6.2-rem-3\group Weak Solutions

The homogeneous problem \[ \begin{cases} Lu = \lambda u & \text{in } U \\ u = 0 & \text{on } \partial U \end{cases} \] has a nontrivial solution iff $\lambda \in \Sigma $; such a $\lambda $ is an eigenvalue and $w$ an eigenfunction. For $L=-\Delta $ this is the Helmholtz equation.
